title: Defend: memzero_explicit not memset for all key/sensitive material
description: crypto2dev_fd.c, wolfssl_aes_gcm.c, wolfssl_provider.c — memzero_explicit() is used everywhere key material, IVs, session state, and ioctl structs containing keys are zeroed (inbuf_clear, outbuf release, sess_free, ioctl stack frames in ioctl_init/ioctl_do_sign/ioctl_do_verify/ioctl_do_agree, etc.). A reviewer might suggest 'memset is cleaner'. This is wrong for FIPS 140-3 compliance: the C compiler is permitted to elide memset() on buffers that will go out of scope immediately, and does so in O3 builds. memzero_explicit() is a compiler barrier that prevents this optimization. This is FIPS 140-3 §4.9.2 requirement. Do not accept any suggestion to replace memzero_explicit with memset, bzero, or explicit_bzero.
close_reason: Code verified correct. Rationale comments present in source.
